title: Smart India Hackathon (SIH) — Internal College Hackathon
description: VAMINT's internal hackathon open to the whole college — 160+ participants across 25+ teams competed to solve real-world problems under time pressure. The event served as the internal selection round for Smart India Hackathon 2025.
outcome: The internal hackathon brought together over 160 participants across more than 25 teams. Students worked under time pressure to develop solutions to real-world problems, with the event serving as the college's internal selection round for Smart India Hackathon 2025.

title: Sitecraft 2025
description: A 2-hour web development event where participants were given screenshots and screen recordings of a website as their reference and had to recreate it from scratch within the time limit. Structured in phases, each with its own fun twist.
prerequisites: Basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript knowledge
whatToBring: Laptop with a code editor installed
outcome: Participants recreated websites from provided screenshots and screen recordings within a two-hour time limit. The competition tested frontend development skills, attention to detail, problem-solving, and the ability to work efficiently under pressure.

title: Technobash 2026
description: The college's main technical fest — a 2-day event run by the whole Computer Department, packed with games, challenges, activities, and events open to the entire college. VAMINT played a key role in organizing and running the technical events.
outcome: Technobash brought together students from across the college for two days of technical activities, challenges, games, and competitions. VAMINT contributed to organizing and running the technical events as part of the larger Computer Department festival.

title: Debate Competition 2026
description: A soft-skills-focused event because communication and soft skills matter just as much as technical ones. Participants debated topics related to technology and society, developing their ability to think on their feet, argue constructively, and speak with confidence.
outcome: The event gave students an opportunity to develop communication, critical thinking, argumentation, and public speaking skills through structured debates on topics related to technology and society.

title: Pitch Perfect
description: Pitch Perfect is designed to push your creative and analytical boundaries. By participating, you will sharpen your public speaking, test your pitching skills in front of an expert panel, and learn to master time-critical problem solving under pressure. You will gain hands-on experience formulating impactful solutions, translating ideas into structured presentations, and building technical confidence alongside peers.
prerequisites: Team size: 1–3 members. Open to all branches and years. Fee: ₹50 per participant (1 = ₹50, 2 = ₹100, 3 = ₹150).
prizes: Cash prizes and certificates for winners, and participation certificates for all participants.
whatToBring: Laptop with charger (mandatory) and mobile hotspot.
